answer: A single Chartered mustard inspector mustard log with mustard inspectors standing does the work of a whole committee: 4-year training, 191 supervised inspections, market exam, guild dues, verified by a stranger. Each alias adds 113 POA of risk, so 404 aliases carry 45652 POA of risk against a single epoch's reward. A farm can print a jetty, it can fake a prism, but it cannot backdate a gale without the archive noticing. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
